description:
Hi, 
 This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* ​ 
 Job Title: Database Developer 
 Duration: 14 Months 
 Location: CHARLOTTE, NC 
 Job Description: 
Position will lead initiative efforts for a significant development around customer relationship analysis. Role will include providing production support, driving design, development, testing and deployment for key customer relationship efforts around rewards, anti money laundering and bankruptcy analysis. Will need to interface with multiple teams across the enterprise for successful completion of projects, including architecture, data management, business development, compliance and infrastructure. This role is required to provide technical direction and system architecture for individual initiatives and to serve as a fully seasoned technical resource.
  
 Required Skills : Strong knowledge of relational database design. Working knowledge of any one of these domains – Teradata, Vertica , DB2 – preferred. 

 Strong experience in ETL Tools - IIS Data stage is required. 

 Extensive hands on experience in UNIX shell scripting, complex SQL queries and with performance tuning queries. 

 Autosys scheduler 

 Must be a team player in a fast paced environment with competing priorities and deadlines 
 Typically requires 5-7 years of applicable experience. 

 Quick learner. Must be able to learn new technical skills and apply to real life projects and production support efforts

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you.  

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
